name: hyperconsciousness
description: Developer-alpha encrypted, append-only knowledge store with scoped, expiring MCP grants; build hc from source and add it to PATH, then initialize a store and grant access: https://github.com/louis030195/hyperconsciousness#install-from-source

env.name: HC_GRANT_ID
env.description: ID of an existing, unexpired grant for this store and local device; create a narrowly scoped grant with hc grant before starting the MCP client

env.name: HC_STORE_DIR
env.description: Absolute path to a store initialized with hc start; the MCP process must run as the OS user that can unlock its keys
